prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic ultra-detailed scene inside a grand Victorian glass-roof railway station at night, wet reflective floor, warm lamps, mist and steam around a sleek blue train, with exact readable typography and object counts.

Canvas: 3:2 horizontal widescreen composition, photorealistic, dramatic teal-and-amber color grade, sharp foreground details, deep background perspective, rainy glass ceiling with iron arches.

Main subject: On the right foreground, a stern elegant middle-aged woman station official named Mara Voss with short silver-gray hair, light skin, wearing a dark emerald-green tailored uniform jacket with gold piping, brass buttons, white shirt, and black tie. Her name badge must read "MARA VOSS". She sits at a polished wooden table and holds a cream paper ticket facing the viewer.

Ticket text: The ticket must be readable and centered with exactly these lines: "NORTHSTAR EXPRESS", "PLATFORM", "9", "DEPARTURE", "21:15". Add a thin decorative border.

Foreground table objects: Include exactly 5 discrete objects on the wooden table, left to right: 1 brass compass, 1 translucent red glass apple, 1 blue origami crane, 1 silver fountain pen, and 1 white coffee mug. The mug must show the exact printed time "07:42".

Background people and props: Include exactly 4 walking figures on the left midground: 1 child in a yellow raincoat holding exactly 1 red balloon, 1 older man in a dark hat and burgundy coat carrying exactly 1 black suitcase, 1 astronaut in a white spacesuit carrying exactly 1 potted sunflower, and the seated station official in the foreground as the fifth human figure overall. Do not add extra people.

Train and station details: Place exactly 1 glossy deep-blue streamlined train in the center background, partly surrounded by steam. Hang a station sign above it reading "AURORA CENTRAL". On the upper left, create a large departure board with exactly 4 destination rows and exact text: "LONDON — ON TIME", "PARIS — 10 MIN LATE", "OSLO — BOARDING", "MARS — CANCELLED". On the upper right, place one ornate round analog clock showing exactly 9:15.

Visual style: High-end cinematic realism, precise typography, accurate reflections of lights and figures on the wet floor and glossy table, ornate black ironwork, warm golden signage, cool blue night atmosphere, shallow-to-medium depth of field but all important text legible.

Constraints: Preserve all exact text strings, counts, and times. No misspellings, no extra signs with competing text, no watermark, no border, no surreal distortions beyond the astronaut and Mars destination.

promptZh:
目标：创建一个电影级超精细场景，背景为夜晚宏伟的维多利亚式玻璃顶火车站，地面湿润且具有反射效果，配有温暖的灯光，一辆时尚的蓝色火车周围环绕着雾气和蒸汽，并要求精确的字体渲染和物体计数。

画布：3:2 水平宽屏构图，照片级真实感，戏剧性的青橙色调，前景细节清晰，背景透视深远，带有铁艺拱门的雨天玻璃天花板。

主体：右侧前景处有一位神情严肃、优雅的中年车站官员，名为 Mara Voss，留着银灰色短发，肤色白皙，身穿深祖母绿色的定制制服夹克，配有金色滚边、黄铜纽扣、白色衬衫和黑色领带。她的姓名牌必须显示为“MARA VOSS”。她坐在抛光的木桌旁，手中拿着一张面向观众的奶油色纸质车票。

车票文本：车票必须清晰可读且居中，包含以下精确行文：“NORTHSTAR EXPRESS”、“PLATFORM”、“9”、“DEPARTURE”、“21:15”。添加一个细装饰边框。

前景桌上物品：木桌上需包含精确的 5 个独立物体，从左至右依次为：1 个黄铜指南针、1 个半透明红色玻璃苹果、1 个蓝色折纸鹤、1 支银色钢笔和 1 个白色咖啡杯。杯子上必须印有精确的时间“07:42”。

背景人物与道具：左侧中景处包含精确的 4 个行走人物：1 名身穿黄色雨衣的孩子拿着 1 个红色气球，1 名戴着深色帽子、身穿酒红色外套的老人提着 1 个黑色手提箱，1 名身穿白色宇航服的宇航员拿着 1 盆向日葵，加上前景中坐着的车站官员，总共 5 个人物。请勿添加额外人物。

火车与车站细节：背景中央放置 1 辆光泽感十足的深蓝色流线型火车，周围部分被蒸汽环绕。火车上方悬挂一块车站站牌，写着“AURORA CENTRAL”。左上方创建一个大型出发项目，包含精确的 4 行目的地信息，文本如下：“LONDON — ON TIME”、“PARIS — 10 MIN LATE”、“OSLO — BOARDING”、“MARS — CANCELLED”。右上方放置一个华丽的圆形模拟时钟，显示时间精确为 9:15。

视觉风格：高端电影级写实主义，精确的字体，湿润地面和光亮桌面上对灯光与人物的准确反射，华丽的黑色铁艺，温暖的金色标牌，冷色调的蓝色夜晚氛围，浅至中等景深，但所有重要文本均清晰可见。

限制：保留所有精确的文本字符串、计数和时间。不得有拼写错误，不得有包含竞争性文本的额外标牌，不得有水印，不得有边框，除宇航员和火星目的地外，不得有超现实的扭曲变形。
